WELCOME TO TYPERUN

Words become
your way forward.

Type the story from left to right. The little runner follows your keystrokes: faster typing, faster running. Stop typing and he stops too.

01

Space finishes a word. Backspace fixes it before you move on. Capitalization is flexible; punctuation follows the story.

02

Some mistakes are a stumble. Familiar typos like teh → the and adjacent letter swaps earn a trip, then you keep going.

03

Other mistakes open the floor. He drops, splats onto a fresh story, gets back up, and you begin again.

Finish a story to move to the next. Press Escape to pause. Your best speed stays on this device.
